tools.name: calculate_boat_loan
tools.description: Runs the yacht.loans boat loan calculator on your numbers: monthly loan payment, payment with insurance, amount financed, balloon left at the end when payments are figured over more years than the term, interest over the term, sales tax (from a state rule on the site or your own rate and cap), cash

tools.name: get_boat_sales_tax
tools.description: The boat sales or use tax rule yacht.loans has confirmed for a state from its statute or tax agency: rate, cap, exemptions or special tests (such as California's 12-month test or Florida's $18,000 cap), the citation, source URL and the date it was read. Omit state to list every state covered.

tools.name: list_boat_lender_terms
tools.description: What banks, credit unions, marine lenders and brokers publish on their own boat loan pages, as read by yacht.loans: rate ranges with their dates, loan amounts, longest terms, down payment and boat age or size rules, with each lender's URL. Filter by lender type or name; not offers and not a ranking.

tools.name: estimate_uscg_documentation_fees
tools.description: Adds up the Coast Guard NVDC fees (46 CFR 67.550) to document a financed recreational boat: Abstract of Title, initial certificate or exchange into your name for 1 to 5 years, bill of sale and preferred mortgage recording by page count, and a certified copy for the lender, plus the full NVDC fee tab

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_boat_sales_tax, list_boat_lender_terms · Private data: estimate_uscg_documentation_fees · Public sink: list_boat_lender_terms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_boat_sales_tax, list_boat_lender_terms · Private data: estimate_uscg_documentation_fees · Public sink: list_boat_lender_terms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
